links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT versus nonspecialist referrers and dermatologists on same cases
links.effect: ChatGPT correct 56% with dermatologist-recorded data and 39% with nonspecialist-recorded data; nonspecialists 36%; dermatologists 83% (n=30).
links.quote: This was similar to the diagnostic rate of nonspecialists (36%; n = 13), but it was much lower than that of dermatologists (83%; n = 30).

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating ChatGPT-4's diagnostic accuracy on anonymized dermatology cases compared to human clinicians without testing a deployment practice.
